items.item_text: For questions regarding this position, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@frc.edu .
Visa Sponsorship
H1B1 visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Associate Degree with coursework in business, or related discipline: AND
One (1) years of customer service record keeping or related experience;
Community college experience is preferred
Any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.
Modern office practices and procedures, experience with the MS Office Suite; strong Excel skills
Coursework or high-level experience with relational databases such as Access or Banner

Coordinate the admissions process for students including students enrolled through Instructional Service Agreements (ISAs), ensuring accurate and timely processing of applications and collection of enrollment documentation.
Coordinate and oversee admissions and records for other programs as assigned.
Serves as the primary liaison for undocumented students enrolled at the college.
Assist with ensuring all admissions comply with federal, state, and institutional regulations, particularly those specific to ISA programs; prepare and submit required reports.
Maintain accurate records of student enrollment, and related documentation, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality
Work closely with other college departments, such as the Registrar, Advising Office, and Financial Aid Office, to ensure comprehensive support for students.
Review and analyze admissions and financial aid applications to detect inconsistencies, false information, or fraudulent documentation.
Conduct thorough investigations into cases of suspected fraud related to admissions and financial aid, including identity theft, falsification of documents, and misrepresentation of financial need.
Establish protocols for identifying and addressing potential fraud, ensuring alignment with institutional policies and regulations.
Work with IT department to prevent fraud, including verification processes, data audits, and cross-checks with external databases
Prepare detailed reports on investigations, including findings, recommendations, and actions taken.
Assist ISP and outside program student enrollments in collaboration with the Admissions & Records Specialist.
Offer support and backup to the Student Account Specialist with student invoicing and collections, as well as managing student accounts and addressing other student account needs.
Other related duties as assigned
Federal, state and other regulations pertaining to college admissions and financial aid
Basic computer use
English composition, grammar, spelling and punctuation
Reading, interpreting and applying regulations, policies, and procedures
Preparing effective reports, memoranda and correspondence
Establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with people of diverse socio-economic backgrounds and/or various disabilities, including under sometimes tense circumstances
Establishing and maintaining a variety of records, data and required reports
Preparing effective written reports and correspondence
Analyzing, managing, and reporting data using spreadsheets and other technology tools such as SQL
Demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic and socio-economic, cultural, disability, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students and staff
Customer service: strong interpersonal skills; oral and written communications; friendly and helpful; and solution-based with problem-solving
